description: This file defines the UserSpace interface, including its properties, functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, and type guards. It references external models User and Group, and includes functions for converting JSON data to UserSpace objects and vice versa.

methods.name: instanceOfUserSpace
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the UserSpace interface.

methods.name: UserSpaceFromJSON
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to a UserSpace instance.

methods.name: UserSpaceFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to a UserSpace instance with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: UserSpaceToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a UserSpace object to JSON.
